parameters.peer_selection: three U.S. public drug distributors sharing SEC SIC 5122 and standard annual XBRL coverage
parameters.fact_selection: latest-filed annual 10-K fact at each entity-specific fiscal year end

parameter_register.boundary: Eight fiscal years per entity improve cross-sectional depth but still do not span every business regime.
Shared industry classification improves relevance but does not make business mix, accounting policy, fiscal timing, or acquisitions identical.
The latest 10-K presentation is used when comparative facts repeat; original filing values can differ after reclassification, and entity fiscal year ends differ.
Illustrative sensitivity, not management guidance or a forecast.
A ratio below 0.8 is a review flag only; it is not an accounting conclusion, credit threshold, or investment signal.
